note: EVAL2 wording with new story structures. Each family gives an ADD and a SUB question over the same two numbers x (written first) and y. ADD gold = x+y. SUB gold = x-y with x>y.

families.add: Can you work out how many {noun} {name} gathered in total? {name} gathered {x} {noun} on Saturday and {y} {noun} on Sunday.
families.sub: Can you work out how many more {noun} {name} gathered on Saturday than on Sunday? {name} gathered {x} {noun} on Saturday and {y} {noun} on Sunday.

families.add: {name} owns {x} {noun} and {name2} owns {y} {noun}. The shop where they were bought has a bright blue door. How many {noun} do the friends own together?
families.sub: {name} owns {x} {noun} and {name2} owns {y} {noun}. The shop where they were bought has a bright blue door. How many fewer {noun} does {name2} own than {name}?

families.add: {noun} sold -> Friday: {x}, Saturday: {y}. What was the combined number of {noun} sold over both days?
families.sub: {noun} sold -> Friday: {x}, Saturday: {y}. What is the difference between Friday's sales and Saturday's sales?

families.add: "I have {x} {noun}," said {name}. "I have {y} {noun}," said {name2}. What is the sum of what {name} and {name2} have?
families.sub: "I have {x} {noun}," said {name}. "I have {y} {noun}," said {name2}. How many more {noun} does {name} have than {name2}?

families.add: Tomorrow, {name} will carry {x} {noun} to the community hall. The hall sits at the end of a quiet street lined with trees. Later {name} will carry {y} {noun} there as well. How many {noun} will {name} have carried to the hall by the end?
families.sub: Tomorrow, {name} will carry {x} {noun} to the community hall. The hall sits at the end of a quiet street lined with trees. Later {name} will carry {y} {noun} there as well. How many fewer {noun} will {name} carry on the later trip than on the earlier trip?

families.add: {name} cycled {x} kilometres on Monday and {y} kilometres on Tuesday. How far did {name} cycle over both days?
families.sub: {name} cycled {x} kilometres on Monday and {y} kilometres on Tuesday. How much farther was Monday's ride than Tuesday's ride, in kilometres?
